meta.title: Phantom Pain (Part II)
meta.description: I don't see another path, so I said I don't have another choice.

units.rawText: (It's routine communication... But at this time... Just my luck!)

units.displayText: My situation... I've made contact with an administrator. I'll return immediately if the Oasis needs me.

spans.text: My situation... I've made contact with an administrator. I'll return immediately if the Oasis needs me.

units.rawText: ...No, don't head back, actually. The place is surrounded by Sanctifiers. I can force my way in, but it'll be a bit too dangerous for a sniper like you.

units.rawText: You don't look so good.

units.displayText: How could that be the case?

spans.text: How could that be the case?

units.rawText: Currently, right is front of me the original prototype of all our agents in the Sector.
units.displayText: Currently, right is front of me the original prototype of all our agents in the Sector.

units.rawText: ...What?
units.displayText: ...What?

spans.text: ...What?

units.rawText: Don't you know?
units.displayText: Don't you know?

spans.text: Don't you know?

units.rawText: Each instance of battle data you gather is sent here. All the agents in Cyclopes are awakened based on some variation of that data.
units.displayText: Each instance of battle data you gather is sent here. All the agents in Cyclopes are awakened based on some variation of that data.

units.displayText: Simo's expression contorts into shock. Olivia looks up, bitterness in her smile.

spans.text: Simo's expression contorts into shock. Olivia looks up, bitterness in her smile.

units.rawText: Yeah, it's exactly what you think it is.
units.displayText: Yeah, it's exactly what you think it is.

spans.text: Yeah, it's exactly what you think it is.

units.rawText: "Battles." We are born for battles.
units.displayText: "Battles." We are born for battles.

spans.text: "Battles." We are born for battles.

units.rawText: I believe you've already seen the wall on your way here.
units.displayText: I believe you've already seen the wall on your way here.

spans.text: I believe you've already seen the wall on your way here.

units.rawText: While we speak, agents on that other side of the wall continue to fight.
units.displayText: While we speak, agents on that other side of the wall continue to fight.

spans.text: While we speak, agents on that other side of the wall continue to fight.

units.rawText: I saw the colossal isolation wall when I came here, yes.
units.displayText: I saw the colossal isolation wall when I came here, yes.

spans.text: I saw the colossal isolation wall when I came here, yes.

units.rawText: For what purpose was it built?
units.displayText: For what purpose was it built?

spans.text: For what purpose was it built?

units.rawText: The agents in Cyclopes are classified into Monitor-types and Combat-types.
units.displayText: The agents in Cyclopes are classified into Monitor-types and Combat-types.

spans.text: The agents in Cyclopes are classified into Monitor-types and Combat-types.

units.rawText: We, the Monitor Agents still remember our original mission, but the Combat-type agents eventually began to execute their orders erratically, in measures too severe.
units.displayText: We, the Monitor Agents still remember our original mission, but the Combat-type agents eventually began to execute their orders erratically, in measures too severe.

spans.text: We, the Monitor Agents still remember our original mission, but the Combat-type agents eventually began to execute their orders erratically, in measures too severe.

units.rawText: Raven built that wall in order to incite and arouse fighting.
units.displayText: Raven built that wall in order to incite and arouse fighting.

spans.text: Raven built that wall in order to incite and arouse fighting.

units.rawText: Now released from the control of the Monitor-types, the Combat-type agents became more and more aggressive and belligerent, casting aside everything for the sake of victory.
units.displayText: Now released from the control of the Monitor-types, the Combat-type agents became more and more aggressive and belligerent, casting aside everything for the sake of victory.

units.rawText: Why must things be like this...
units.displayText: Why must things be like this...

spans.text: Why must things be like this...

units.rawText: Aside from Raven, did my data contribute to the direction in which the Combat-type agents' behavior evolved?
units.displayText: Aside from Raven, did my data contribute to the direction in which the Combat-type agents' behavior evolved?

spans.text: Aside from Raven, did my data contribute to the direction in which the Combat-type agents' behavior evolved?

units.rawText: I lack the rights to make such a judgment. I'm merely an administrator here.
units.displayText: I lack the rights to make such a judgment. I'm merely an administrator here.

spans.text: I lack the rights to make such a judgment. I'm merely an administrator here.

units.rawText: However, I have a favor to ask of you, if I may be so bold.
units.displayText: However, I have a favor to ask of you, if I may be so bold.

spans.text: However, I have a favor to ask of you, if I may be so bold.

units.rawText: ...What is it?
units.displayText: ...What is it?

spans.text: ...What is it?

units.rawText: Please help us shatter that wall to cut off the vicious cycle of battling in Cyclopes.
units.displayText: Please help us shatter that wall to cut off the vicious cycle of battling in Cyclopes.

spans.text: Please help us shatter that wall to cut off the vicious cycle of battling in Cyclopes.

units.rawText: There's no chance we'll be able to subdue blood-thirsty compatriots in their endless pursuit of victory so long as the wall still stands.
units.displayText: There's no chance we'll be able to subdue blood-thirsty compatriots in their endless pursuit of victory so long as the wall still stands.

spans.text: There's no chance we'll be able to subdue blood-thirsty compatriots in their endless pursuit of victory so long as the wall still stands.

units.rawText: But with the help of an original, like you, there might be a ray of hope.
units.displayText: But with the help of an original, like you, there might be a ray of hope.

spans.text: But with the help of an original, like you, there might be a ray of hope.

units.rawText: I'd like to offer my assistance. But, as you have witnessed, I have other important companions, and they are in a time of need.
units.displayText: I'd like to offer my assistance. But, as you have witnessed, I have other important companions, and they are in a time of need.

units.rawText: However, battles can be very operand-consuming, and I can provide you with operands.

units.rawText: The standing issue is that I do not have full administrative control. The other half currently rests in the hands of my partner, who has long since lost control.

units.rawText: You mean...
units.displayText: You mean...

units.displayText: If you can help us with this situation, I can offer you the operands needed for resupplying and replenishing after fighting.
